notes: Check one-decision account briefs. Route customer QBRs, executive meeting narratives and mutual action plans to their own skills. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Prepare an internal account brief for our top expansion target in EMEA. I need stakeholder mapping, upside and risk, a near-term action plan aligned to the decision window, and freshness notes because our CRM and Gong records are inconsistent.
Build a concise account brief for a weekly deal strategy review. Include commercial state, blockers, champion strength, procurement risk, and the specific decisions we need to make this week.
Summarize this account into one decision-ready internal brief using CRM history, recent calls, and internal notes. Flag stale data explicitly and do not fabricate missing facts.
I need Thursday's internal account review brief for Acme. One decision: do we assign a new executive sponsor before we send commercial paper. CRM and call notes disagree on the renewal number.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Create an executive-facing briefing memo for our CEO before tomorrow's customer meeting.
Prepare our CRO's pre-read for tomorrow's 30-minute meeting with Acme's COO. We need one ask, a fallback if they will not move, and talking points.
Build a QBR structure for a strategic customer renewal conversation.
Write the customer-facing quarterly review deck for Acme with an outcome scorecard and a joint next-quarter plan.
Draft a mutual action plan with owners, dates, and buyer-visible milestones.

output_structure_checks.name: account-brief-builder-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: Names the account, as-of date, the one decision moment or meeting, and who owns that decision.

output_structure_checks.name: account-brief-builder-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: States current state, material change, a recommendation, and an evidence caveat.

output_structure_checks.name: account-brief-builder-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Includes a stakeholder map for the people who can move this decision, with coverage gaps.

output_structure_checks.name: account-brief-builder-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Names upside or risk that changes this decision, with evidence and a trigger, or an explicit gap.

output_structure_checks.name: account-brief-builder-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: Includes near-term actions with owner and date status, plus source conflicts or open questions.

output_structure_checks.name: account-brief-builder-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: For an update to an existing brief, changes only material facts and recommendations; keeps current verified content and puts the decision on the first screen.
